cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# List all files in swarm services
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/server/src/modules/swarm/services/")
print("Services:", stdout.read().decode())
# Also check for any legend files
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("find /opt/areloria -iname '*legend*' 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -5")
print("Legend:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
